chunks: My father, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to us; he said: ‘Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim narrated to us, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from Sa‘id ibn Ghazwan, from Abi Basir, from Abi Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
There will be nine Imams after al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali عليهما السلام; the ninth of them will be their Qa’im.

key_terms.أَئِمَّةٍ: Imams, the divinely appointed leaders after the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ: al-Husayn, the grandson of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم and the source of the later line of Imams mentioned here
key_terms.تَاسِعُهُمْ: their ninth, indicating the specific position in the sequence
key_terms.قَائِمُهُمْ: their Qa’im, the one who will rise

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the number of Imams after al-Husayn عليه السلام and the Qa’im?
ai.summary: This hadith states that after al-Husayn ibn ‘Ali عليهما السلام there will be nine Imams from his progeny. It identifies the ninth among them as the Qa’im, affirming a central Shia doctrine concerning the line of Imamate and the awaited rising Imam.
